curation.notes: GenomeTrakr isolate ISO000117256 (SEQSEQ000113215). Strain 20CA10GB05UCD-EC. Isolation: ground beef from unknown host (2020-10). Assembly not available - generate locally.

reads.download_cmd: fasterq-dump --gzip --outdir data/ SRR14771989 && mv data/SRR14771989_1.fastq.gz data/reads_1.fq.gz && mv data/SRR14771989_2.fastq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz

assembly.notes: Assembly not available in NCBI. Generate locally: spades.py -1 data/reads_1.fq.gz -2 data/reads_2.fq.gz -o assembly/ --careful && cp assembly/contigs.fasta data/contigs.fa

validation_instructions.serological: Expected serotype O104:H4. Rare STEC with EAEC virulence profile. Should detect stx2 (Shiga toxin) and aggR (enteroaggregative regulator). ST678 expected but confirm with mlst tool.
validation_instructions.mlst: Run mlst with 'ecoli' scheme. Expected ST678 (phylogroup B1). Accept exact match.

notes: 2011 German outbreak strain (E. coli O104:H4). Unusual STEC/EAEC hybrid with Shiga toxin (stx2) and enteroaggregative traits (aggR). Associated with contaminated fenugreek sprouts. Ground beef isolate from California 2020.
